unresolved.why: West Kordofan (En Nuhud, Ghubaysh, Abyei, Es Salam, Lagawa…) was cut out of both NE Kordofan atoms; its lines run inside them.
unresolved.needs: Sudan locality atoms (e.g. OCHA COD-AB SDN ADM2, licence to check)

unresolved.what: North, West and South Kordofan since 2013
unresolved.why: Restored West Kordofan again takes territory from both NE atoms.

Sources disagree whether Central Darfur (2012) was taken only from West Darfur (statoids: all localities found were West Darfur) or also from South Darfur (en.wikipedia); so the pre-2012 West/South line inside these atoms is not settled.
checked: NE areas vs. stated areas (WD+CD 84,053 vs 79,460 km²; SD+ED 136,213 vs 127,300 km²: both ≈+6%, inconclusive)
unresolved.needs: Sudan locality atoms with pre-2012 locality-to-state membership (e.g. OCHA COD-AB SDN ADM2 of 2011, licence to check)

unresolved.what: Hala'ib triangle and Bir Tawil (country-outline caveat, no atom withheld)
unresolved.why: NE draws Hala'ib (administered by Sudan as part of Red Sea until Egyptian control in the 1990s) in Egypt, and puts Bir Tawil (never administered by Sudan) inside SDN-149 Red Sea. The Red Sea outline therefore follows NE's country line, not the state's exact line.
checked: NE geometry point tests (Hala'ib → EGY-1556; Bir Tawil → SDN-149)
unresolved.needs: a polity outline decision for Hala'ib/Bir Tawil (country layer), not finer admin atoms

unresolved.what: Layouts before 1991 (1956 provinces; 1973/74 and 1976 provinces; 1980–91 regions)
unresolved.why: Out of scope here: not established that the 1956–1991 inter-provincial lines (Nile province formed 1974 from parts of Northern and Kassala; Kafia Kingi moved to Darfur 1960) coincide with NE lines; dates of 1973/1974 conflict between sources.
unresolved.needs: district-level atoms with 1956–1991 lines (none open found)
